title: Three Shifts and One Short Switch
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：mode　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mode 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the operator ① chose the mode that no trainee in the station would have described, and he said the choosing was the whole of the shift. The ② mode, meaning the way itself and not the switch, ran three shifts and stayed undescribed in the book; a mode, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ mode in that station had the same short switch beside it, and the ④ mode at the far screen, meaning the cable they kept for the children to check and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A mode, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the operator said the describing is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the mode was the whole of the matter, meaning the habit and not the way. The ⑥ mode, meaning the habit and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; mode, he said, is either something you choose or the only word that means both a way and a habit. He said the habit is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ mode had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short switch. The ⑧ mode of the whole thing, the operator wrote in June, was one station and three shifts of describing; mode, he said, is either the cable at the far screen or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ mode I remember is the way described in the log, which closed in 1982 and is still described as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ mode, my mother said in 1984, is the only way that improves by being described; every mode, she said, is a habit that has agreed to look like a way. She said the habit was the honest half.

answers.why: choose the mode 意为“选定这一种方式”，1975 年那位操作员把机房里没有一位实习生肯描述的一种方式做了一遍。
mode 意为“方式；模式”，指那种方式本身而不是小小的开关，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被描述。
mode 意为“方式；模式”，指机房里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一个小小的开关。
mode 意为“方式；模式”，指最远那块屏幕的留给孩子们查的那一根，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
mode 意为“方式、习惯”，指一件事里人人都按却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种习惯就是那件事的全部。
mode 意为“习惯”，指人人都按却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种方式，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
mode 意为“方式；模式”，指运行日志里写到、被描述的那一种，到 1980 年这一种成了运行日志里的一行。
mode 意为“方式之事”，操作员六月写道，整件事的方式之事是一处机房和三个班次的描述。
mode 意为“方式；模式”，我记得的是运行日志里描述过的那一种，1982 年调好了，至今仍被说成机房里最安静的一种。
mode 为抽象总称，母亲 1984 年说，方式是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的方式。
